pr_title: Prevent assert if stack trace has function pointer

issue_context.title: NativeAOT: Application crash during exception stack building
issue_context.body:
I receive following exception.

```
 native\ICustomMarshaler_TargetWindows
Unhandled Exception: EETypeRva:0x0074DFF0(System.Diagnostics.DebugProvider.DebugAssertException):    at System.Diagnostics.DebugProvider.Fail(String, String) + 0x4b
   at System.Diagnostics.Debug.Fail(String, String) + 0x45
   at System.Diagnostics.Debug.Assert(Boolean, String, String) + 0x3c
   at System.Diagnostics.Debug.Assert(Boolean) + 0x27
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitTypeName(Handle, Boolean) + 0x4f9
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitTypeSpecificationName(TypeSpecificationHandle, Boolean) + 0x6f
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitTypeName(Handle, Boolean) + 0x16f
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitTypeVector(HandleCollection) + 0xb7
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitMethodParameters(MethodSignature) + 0x78
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitMethodReferenceName(MemberReferenceHandle) + 0xe4
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.EmitMethodName(Handle) + 0x8d
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.MethodNameFormatter.FormatMethodName(MetadataReader, Handle) + 0xa2
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.StackTraceMetadata.PerModuleMethodNameResolver.GetMethodNameFromRvaIfAvailable(Int32) + 0xa2
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.StackTraceMetadata.GetMethodNameFromStartAddressIfAvailable(IntPtr) + 0x189
   at Internal.StackTraceMetadata.StackTraceMetadata.StackTraceMetadataCallbacksImpl.TryGetMethodNameFromStartAddress(IntPtr) + 0x26
   at Internal.DeveloperExperience.DeveloperExperience.CreateStackTraceString(IntPtr, Boolean) + 0x121
   at System.Diagnostics.StackFrame.AppendToStackTrace(StringBuilder) + 0x124
   at System.Diagnostics.StackTrace.ToString(StackTrace.TraceFormat, StringBuilder) + 0x96
   at System.Diagnostics.StackTrace.ToString(StackTrace.TraceFormat) + 0x5a
   at System.Exception.GetStackTrace() + 0x4b
   at System.Exception.get_StackTrace() + 0xae
   at System.Exception.ToString() + 0x14e
   at System.Runtime.CompilerServices.DefaultInterpolatedStringHandler.AppendFormatted[T](T) + 0x235
   at System.Runtime.InteropServices.Tests.ICustomMarshalerTests.Main(String[]) + 0x12d
   at System.Runtime.EH.DispatchEx(StackFrameIterator&, EH.ExInfo&, UInt32) + 0x576
   at System.Runtime.EH.RhThrowEx(Object, EH.ExInfo&) + 0x8d
   at ICustomMarshaler_TargetWindows!<BaseAddress>+0x51c607
   at ICustomMarshaler_TargetWindows!<BaseAddress>+0x51c6a0
```

Exception happens when `typeHandle.HandleType` from this line has value `HandleType.FunctionPointerSignature`
https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/b2dc37ba181a7fa4427e717eab819ba3543d0ae4/src/coreclr/nativeaot/System.Private.StackTraceMetadata/src/Internal/StackTraceMetadata/MethodNameFormatter.cs#L212

so I assume that if stack trace has function pointer signature then whole app crash. 
I will work on the fix. Have just one question, should I wrote test for that, and where if any.

review_comments:
Usage of explicit type (for reference: [Coding Guidelines](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/25d999b5a6711fc6d2ffc42fa38a58ec865a7232/docs/coding-guidelines/coding-style.md?plain=1#L26)))

```suggestion
            StackTrace stackTrace = FunctionPointerParameter(null);
```
I see `var` style used a lot in this file. I would say most of the time.

Nit: Can you add a new line before line 394 to improve code readability

```suggestion

        [MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoOptimization | MethodImplOptions.NoInlining)]
```
